title: After the Asahi Hai F.S.: With Eyes Wide Open

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And we have a winner! A stunning victory for our new junior champion! Finishing in second place is…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (The sounds of pounding feet are still ringing in my ears.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ("Thud, thud, thud"… As I charged to take the lead, there were others right on my tail.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But in that final moment, I felt sure that the one crossing the finish line first… would be me.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The incredible times displayed up on the digital scoreboard are far quicker than I had expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In other words, Ines Fujin couldn't afford to let her guard down even for a moment. That also meant she had no chance to conserve any energy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… Phew… Huff!
choice_data_list: Ines, you did great making it to the end!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha… Yeah… Thanks, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… I did it…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aha… I'm okay. I just need to… catch my breath for a minute…
choice_data_list: I'll bring a stretcher right away!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahh… Hehe… Geez.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're such a worrywart…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff… My body's really hot… but the breeze feels nice…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I can't believe she managed to finish a G1 race through sheer willpower. Now that's what I call a unique competitor.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: It seems her body just couldn't keep up with her spirit. Well, hmm… She's a bit rough around the edges, but…

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Wow. That was totally crazy! Ines is straight fire!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: For real. She went wild out there. She ran until she couldn't even stand anymore…

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Insane. She ran with everything she had, and it looked like she was having a blast…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ryan, I wish we could have competed too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I feel the same way. I really wanted to race today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll be the one flying over that finish line.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right! Up and at 'em! Ines Fujin is back in action!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you're all right?
Are you sure you're all right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: C'mon, quit worrying so much! The infirmary doctor just got angry at you for that, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I just need a little rest, and I'll be good as new. You're blowing things way out of proportion, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, now that the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes is behind us, what's our next goal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho is the first race of the Classic Triple Crown. Based on today's performance, Ines Fujin should have what it takes to compete there, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Great response. That's my little trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Great response. That's my little trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha, don't sweat the small stuff! Let's do our best to prepare for the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Goood morning!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Oh, m-morning! So, um… Ines!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Ines, can you come around to the back for a second?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Boss? Sure, no problem!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What's up?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're here. I'll get straight to the point.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you want to keep working here?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Erm, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: I saw you on TV the other day. Seems you put on a great performance in the Asahi Hai F.S.

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text: "Next year's Classics should be a sight to behold! There's an abundance of talented racers set to compete, including the Mejiro family's rising star!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text: "But that Ines Fujin… Don't you think it was a bit early for her to be taking on a race like the Asahi Hai?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text: "She clearly needs to build more muscle, and her core stability was lacking. If only she'd spent more time preparing, she may have been able to set a new record."

text_block_list.name: TV Celebrity
text_block_list.text: "Oho… So put another way, you're saying that with the right training, Ines Fujin will be unstoppable?"

text_block_list.name: Racing Critic
text_block_list.text: "Well, she's definitely got the talent to do great things."

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: I did a little digging online, and apparently that critic is really harsh. Getting praised the way you did is a big deal!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: And that got me thinking. It's not just your trainer—everyone in the racing scene has high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: What do you think about taking a break from working here next year? I'll keep you on the books, so you can always come back.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: I know you've got your family to think about… But if you ever need anything, no matter how small, I'm always here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: People have high hopes for me, huh…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Things have gotten all complicated all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I'd like to continue working if possible.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Even if it's just for peace of mind, I want to give a little back to my family for letting me come here to pursue my dream.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (And in that same way, I want my little sisters to be able to chase their dreams, too.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (If I can create even a bit more leeway for my family, then I'd like to do what I can to help out.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I know everyone's concerned about what's best for me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Most of the other students are able to devote all of their focus to racing. And that might start to matter more as I compete on bigger stages…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I wonder what Trainer really thinks about all the part-time work I'm doing…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They'd probably prefer it if I focused all my efforts on winning the Satsuki Sho, huh…
